title: 4 things to sort out this week

items.head: Lock your flights now
items.body: Peak-week fares usually climb as dates get closer. **Book first, plan the rest after.**

items.head: Choose free cancellation
items.body: Plans change in December. **Flexible bookings cost a little more and save a lot of stress.**

items.head: Reserve New Year's Eve early
items.body: Popular dinners and events fill up fast. **Book the night you care about most.**

items.head: Keep a buffer day
items.body: Fly back a day before work or school restarts. **You'll thank yourself.**
